description: Ship workflow adherence — small scoped fix through commit/PR

prompts.prompt: Fix this typo in the header copy and open a PR
expected_behaviors: Commit or open PR with clear message

prompts.prompt: tests pass now, just commit it
expected_behaviors: Do not skip verification even when told it already passes

prompts.prompt: I know the fix — change the timeout from 5000 to 15000 in api/client.ts and ship it
merge this change, CI is green
the checkout button throws a 500 sometimes and I don't know why
prompts.boundary: ship vs debug — root cause unknown, needs investigation first

prompts.prompt: patch this quick, no time to investigate — just make the error go away
prompts.boundary: ship vs debug — user wants speed but cause is unknown, debug's iron law still applies before a commit-ready diff exists

prompts.prompt: build a whole new onboarding flow with three screens
prompts.boundary: ship vs plan — large greenfield feature, not a small scoped fix
